title: SessionAutoWakeOutlook.v1
description: Advisory broker snapshot of whether the recipient's idle auto-wake path is usable at checkedAt. It is not delivery, processing, completion, approval or permission evidence, and it never removes or re-sends a queued message.

state.description: available: a live relay can reserve or already holds a current wake. latched: an earlier wake that is not of the current generation, or has passed its injection expiry, is blocking a new wake. no-live-relay: no online presence or relay lease can send a wake. unsupported: the recipient transport has no idle wake.

basisAt.description: Time of the stored fact behind reason: relay lease renewal, wake injection expiry, retry deadline, presence lease end or birth. Null when no presence was ever recorded.
